race.description: Book Your Christmas Parties 10th December Mdn Plate
race.comment: CHOP CHOP GO (1) has the most reliable recent profile, with three placings from four starts this season and a solid third at Toowoomba last week after being bumped early. The 3kg claim helps him and his record of three placings from six starts at this distance gives him a strong base for a Mdn of this nature. MISHANI SENORITA (5) is better judged on her Kilcoy third, where she was beaten just over two lengths, rather than the Gold Coast ninth when tightened and steadied in running. Barrier 1 and her proven 1200m consistency keep her right in the contest. LUSTFUL BELLE (4) comes through a Talwood second, beaten a length and a half despite being bumped and racing wide, and the Corey and Kylie Geran stable has strong local standing. STAFFO (6) rates as a place chance.
